US9589231B2.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for assisting medical diagnosis by exploiting similarity between new medical cases and existing cases and experts in a common embedding space.

Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.entity_name: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.description: The title of the patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based system that assists diagnosis by matching new medical cases to existing cases and experts.

Diagnosis Assistance Method.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, allows selection between query-for-cases and query-for-experts, and returns subsets based on computed similarity.

Embedding Space.description: A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, experts, and documents are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.

New Medical Case.description: A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space for comparison.

Existing Medical Cases.description: A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space, against which a new medical case is compared to return a similar subset.

Experts.description: A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as their profile, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases, who may be selected to formulate a diagnosis.

Requester.description: A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from the available query types.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.

Medical Ontology.description: A set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used to compute representations of medical cases and experts.

Unified Medical Language System.description: A medical ontology on which the embedding of medical cases and experts is based.

Multidimensional Representation.description: A computed representation of a medical case based on the medical ontology, used to measure similarity within the embedding space.

Matrix Of Proximities.description: A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.

Similarity Measure.description: A computed similarity between the representation of the new case and representations of existing cases or experts, used to identify and return subsets.

Public Database.description: A database from which documents are returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space when query-for-cases is selected.

Diagnosis.description: The medical determination formulated by a selected expert to whom a new case is provided.

Payment.description: A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when the query-for-experts is selected.

Patient Records.description: A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.

Computer Processor.description: A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps of the method.

Memory.description: A component storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method, in communication with a processor for executing the instructions.

Computer Program Product.description: A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that when executed on a computer cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor for executing the diagnosis assistance method.

Requester.description: A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.

Experts.description: A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be queried and to whom new cases may be communicated for diagnosis.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded experts.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.

Processor.description: A component in communication with memory that executes stored instructions.

Memory.description: A component that stores instructions for performing the query and diagnosis assistance operations.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory and a processor that provides diagnosis assistance by handling queries for cases and experts.

Network.description: A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices linking requesters and experts with the system.

User Devices.description: A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.

Diagnosis.description: The determination sought for a new medical case, which an expert may attempt to provide.

Multidimensional Representation.description: A representation of a medical case or expert generated in the embedding space.

Diagnosis Assistance Method.description: A method for diagnosis assistance that generates multidimensional representations, handles query types at differing costs, and identifies subsets of cases or experts.
